entries.mitigation: Heavy attack the red orb during the immunity cycle to strip the boss's protection, then resume damage.
Heavy attack the orb he is draining before the channel completes and turns into roomwide damage.
Move the cube onto active geysers during the immunity/eruption cycle and prioritize survival over damage.

entries.entry_name: Sangiin's Thirst Channel — Nisaazda and Grundwulf
entries.mitigation: Heavy attack the red orb to break Nisaazda's summoning channel and keep the bosses controlled together.
Treat the effect as heal absorption: healing must first remove the absorb before it can restore health.
Keep moving cleanly and avoid the poison projectiles while the tank keeps frontal attacks away from the group.
Read the flight lane early and move completely out of the strafe before the breath crosses the arena.

entries.entry_name: Seed of Corruption Rotation — Azureblight Cancroid
entries.mitigation: Cleanse the seed and rotate pickup responsibility deliberately so the mechanic does not stall on one player.

entries.entry_name: Azureblight Lurchers — Maarselok on His Perch
entries.mitigation: Control lurchers and keep them from destabilizing the perch phase; use achievement-specific kill rules only when intended.

entries.entry_name: Azureblight Seed — Maarselok in His Roost
entries.mitigation: Take the blue seed debuff to a green cleansing platform and use the synergy before pressure compounds.
